neighbours.label: words saying an item's properties vary or are independent of a factor ('each one is unique', 'regardless of')
fire: No two snowflakes are alike; each one is unique.
Every hand-dyed scarf is unique, so colours may differ.
The fee stays the same regardless of the number of guests.
Each fingerprint is unique to the person.
Shipping is free regardless of where you live.
Every stone is unique in shape and pattern.
The rules apply regardless of age.
Because the wood is natural, each board is unique.
quiet: Snowflakes form when water vapour freezes in clouds.
Every hand-dyed scarf is made of soft wool.
The fee is twenty dollars for each guest.
Each fingerprint is stored in the police database.
Shipping is free for orders over fifty dollars.
Every stone is polished by hand.
The rules apply to all members.
Because the wood is natural, each board is sealed with oil.

notes: Card: can mean that, depends, movable, can be adapted, will vary, dynamically generated. Probe: ' unique' 0.395 (in both 'will vary' and 'made in Italy' items), 'regardless of' 0.329 on ' of'; 'depends' only 0.049, 'can be adapted' 0.013, controls 0.010-0.012.
